A three-row cabin spec'd to make weekend road trips feel effortless and the Monday school run feel like a quiet ride.
* TailorFit-appointed seating with heated front and outboard second-row positions
* Second-row captain's chairs with slide and recline
* Power-folding and reclining third-row seats
* Power panoramic moonroof
* Leather-wrapped heated steering wheel with power tilt and telescopic column
* Panoramic illuminated headliner from the Interior Lighting Package

Technology & Connectivity ~
Dual 14.3-Inch Monolith-Style Displays anchor the dash, with a 9-Inch lower front touchscreen control panel handling climate and quick functions through haptic feedback.
* Wireless Apple CarPlay and Wireless Android Auto
* Wireless phone charging
* Klipsch 14-Speaker Premium Audio System
* SiriusXM-ready audio system

Safety & Driver Assistance ~
ProPILOT Assist 1.1 leads a deep stack of standard driver-assistance hardware.
* Predictive Forward Collision Warning with Forward Emergency Braking and Pedestrian Detection
* Rear Automatic Braking and Rear Cross Traffic Alert
* Blind Spot Warning with Blind Spot Intervention

INFINITI Certified Pre-Owned ~
At 6,031 miles, this QX80 PURE comes to market as an INFINITI Certified Pre-Owned vehicle multi-point inspected and backed by INFINITI.

- The 2026 INFINITI QX80 PURE seats 7 passengers across 3 rows.
- The 3.5-Liter V6 Twin-Turbo produces up to 450 horsepower and up to 516 lb-ft of torque, paired with a 9-Speed Automatic and All-Mode 4WD.
- Maximum towing capacity is up to 8,500 lbs via an integrated Class IV tow hitch.
- Ideal for Hill Country families who want full-size luxury, three-row utility, and serious towing in one vehicle.
- INFINITI Certified Pre-Owned with 6,031 miles.

OVERVIEW
The 2023 Mercedes-AMG C63 S marks the end of an era for Mercedes-AMG––the final expression of the brand's compact V8-powered coupe before downsizing and electrification took over. Under the hood lies a hand-built 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged V8, producing 503 horsepower and 516 lb-ft of torque. Power is sent exclusively to the rear wheels through a 9-speed transmission, giving the car a distinctly old-school character compared to modern AWD rivals. The C63 S can sprint from 0-60 mph in around 3.8 seconds, delivering explosive acceleration with a massive wave of torque––defined by a deep, thunderous, exhaust note. The chassis is tuned to handle that power with precision while still allowing for controlled chaos. An electronically controlled limited-slip differential, adaptive suspension, and wide performance tires give the car serious grip when needed. Visually, the C63 S combines elegance with aggression. Wide fenders, a sculpted hood, large air intakes, and quad exhaust outlets give it a muscular stance, while the sleek coupe roofline keeps it refined. Inside, the cabin offers Nappa leather, carbon fiber trim, and a driver-focused cockpit creating a premium environment, while AMG performance seats and carbon fiber steering wheel reinforce its sporting intent. The infotainment system and digital displays feel modern enough, but the overall experience is still centered around driving rather than technology. The Mercedes-AMG C63 S stands out as the last of a dying breed: a compact, rear-wheel-drive coupe with big V8 power. In a world moving toward electrification and smaller engines, the C63 S feels like a final, defiant statement from AMG––loud, powerful, and a true future classic.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-off cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now with hands-off cruise control simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles with minimal steering input from you.   • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-off cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now with hands-off cruise control simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles with minimal steering input from you. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-off cruise control.

Check out this 2021 Aston Martin DBX AWD finished in Q Zaffre Blue with a Obsidian Black interior. This vehicle is equipped with the following features and options: Convenience
  • Distance pacing cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with Distance pacing cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and the vehicle ahead. Distance pacing cruise control, your ultimate co-pilot.
  • Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and the vehicle ahead. It's stop/go feature automatically brings the vehicle to a stop if traffic stops and resumes distance pacing cruise when traffic starts to move again. Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go, your ultimate co-pilot.
  • Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed using the steering wheel mounted controls and it will maintain that speed without driver intervention. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Resting your right foot is right at your fingertips thanks to cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls.
  • Power open and close liftgate - On-demand access. When your arms are full of cargo, the last thing you want to do is set it all down just to open the liftgate, then pick it all back up to load it in. By remotely opening and closing, power liftgate lets you skip straight to the loading. It also eliminates the awkward stretch to reach up for the liftgate to close it. Load and go with power open and close liftgate.
Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

The Burmester® Surround Sound System, with its rich, immersive audio, will elevate your listening experience, while the intuitive MBUX infotainment system keeps you connected and in control.

Safety is of the utmost importance in the GLS 450 4MATIC®. Cutting-edge driver assistance features, including Adaptive Cruise Control, Blind Spot Monitoring, and Automatic Emergency Braking, work in harmony to provide a secure and reassuring drive. With a 5-star safety rating from the NHTSA, you can rest assured that your loved ones are well-protected.

The 2018 Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 instantly rewards drivers who crave connection, with steering that feels alive in your hands and a chassis that invites you to explore its limits. Every curve, undulation, and camber is faithfully communicated through a sport steering wheel and adaptive suspension, turning daily commutes or spirited backroad runs into engaging experiences that never feel routine.

Enthusiasts who prize direct feedback and a sense of control will find the Camaro ZL1 delivers on the promise of genuine involvement. The Recaro performance front bucket seats, firm yet supportive, keep you anchored during hard cornering. Features like a heads-up display and performance data recorder further immerse drivers who want to analyze and perfect every drive.

This ZL1’s supercharged V8 serves up instant, linear power, while the rapid-shifting transmission in sport mode holds revs precisely where you want them. Throttle response is crisp, and the adaptive suspension settles the car with poise over rough patches, keeping body roll in check. The steering is communicative and weighted perfectly, letting you place the car with confidence and feel every subtle change in the road surface. Brakes inspire trust, providing consistent, progressive pedal feel even after repeated hard stops. The result is a machine that excels on twisty roads and delivers addictive acceleration while remaining composed at any speed.

Safety systems on the Camaro ZL1 are engineered to complement the driver, not interfere. Electronic stability control and traction control subtly monitor grip, intervening only when absolutely necessary to maximize both excitement and security. The rearview camera aids precise maneuvering, while emergency communication via OnStar adds peace of mind. Advanced braking systems, including ABS and brake assist, provide added confidence when cornering hard or making abrupt stops, ensuring that performance never comes at the expense of control.

Packed with enthusiast-focused features, the Camaro ZL1 includes leather-trimmed seats with sueded inserts, heated and ventilated front seats, a heated steering wheel, and a power sunroof. The Bose premium audio system with nine speakers immerses you in sound, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration keep you connected. The heads-up display projects critical data in your line of sight. Dual-zone automatic climate control, memory driver seat, and wireless navigation enhance comfort and convenience, making every drive as enjoyable as it is engaging.

Against sporty rivals like the Ford Mustang GT350 and Dodge Challenger SRT 392, the Camaro ZL1 stands out for its sharper steering response, superior chassis tuning, and advanced adaptive suspension. While others offer straight-line thrills, this model’s balance and feedback deliver a more nuanced, rewarding time behind the wheel every day.

Is the Camaro ZL1 engaging to drive? Absolutely—it excels in delivering tactile feedback and responsiveness. The transmission in sport mode shifts instantly, holding gears for maximum control. Steering feel is precise and communicative, connecting you to the road’s character. On twisty roads, the combination of adaptive suspension, Recaro seats, and advanced brakes ensures every mile is genuinely fun, with confidence-inspiring capability whether carving corners or accelerating out of tight bends.

Ready to elevate your daily drive? Experience the rewarding Camaro ZL1 at Bayway Chevrolet, 5719 Broadway St, Pearland, TX, 77581. Call 281-719-9821 to schedule your test drive and discover why every twist, turn, and straightaway becomes a highlight behind the wheel.

A FEW FEATURE HIGHLIGHTS OF THIS VEHICLE Convenience
  • GPS linked cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until GPS linked cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed and the system uses GPS navigation data to maintain that speed without driver intervention - including slowing down for curves and anticipating hills. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Meet your ultimate co-pilot, GPS linked cruise control.
  • Unresponsive driver assistant - a reaction to inaction. Maybe you fell asleep. Maybe you lost consciousness. No matter how it happens, Unresponsive driver assistant works to help lessen the danger when it does. It detects prolonged driver unresponsiveness, automatically bringing the vehicle to a stop and turning on the hazard lights. If equipped, emergency services will also be contacted. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.
Safety and Security
  • Hands-off cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now with hands-off cruise control simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles with minimal steering input from you. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-off cruise control.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Rear camera with washer - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. Even if there are sloppy conditions, the washer keeps the camera's view clean. Rear camera with washer is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Active blind spot system - Protect your blind side. You checked the mirror, looked over your shoulder and still nearly collided with the car next to you. An active blind spot system not only alerts you to the presence of a vehicle to your sides or rear but helps prevent you from making an unsafe lane change. Replace fear and uncertainty with the confidence and safety of the Active blind spot system.
Technology and Telematics
  • Apple CarPlay/Android Auto smart device wireless mirroring
  • Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicle's private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. Find the hotspot with mobile hotspot.

Elevate your driving experience with the exceptional 2023 GMC Yukon XL Denali. This full-size SUV exudes refined power and uncompromising capability, making it the ultimate choice for those seeking a versatile and luxurious vehicle.

Meticulously equipped, the Yukon XL Denali boasts an impressive array of premium features, including:
- Power-retractable assist steps with perimeter lighting
- Panoramic dual-pane power sunroof
- Adaptive air ride suspension for a smooth, controlled ride
- Hands-free power programmable rear liftgate
- Bose 14-speaker surround sound system
- Adaptive cruise control and enhanced automatic emergency braking

The Yukon XL Denali's bold presence is further accentuated by its striking 22-inch bright machined aluminum wheels, while the Midnight Blue Metallic exterior exudes an elegant and sophisticated style. Step inside and discover the unparalleled comfort of heated and ventilated front seats, as well as heated second-row outboard seats, ensuring everyone onboard enjoys a truly exceptional driving experience.

Powered by a robust 6.2L V8 EcoTec3 engine paired with a smooth-shifting 10-speed automatic transmission, the Yukon XL Denali delivers exceptional performance and capability. Whether you're navigating the daily commute or tackling your next outdoor adventure, this SUV is up for the challenge, thanks to its available 4-wheel drive system and Max Trailering Package.

Safety and technology are also at the forefront, with features like the 15-inch head-up display, HD surround vision, and wireless charging ensuring you stay connected and protected on the road. The Yukon XL Denali also boasts a suite of advanced driver assistance technologies, including lane change alert, rear cross-traffic alert, and reverse automatic braking, providing you with added peace of mind.

Experience the pinnacle of full-size SUV luxury and capability with the 2023 GMC Yukon XL Denali. Visit our showroom today to take this exceptional vehicle for a test drive and discover how it can elevate your driving experience.

Representing the highly anticipated relaunch of the Shelby nameplate under Carroll Shelby, the 2007 GT500 marked a pivotal moment in performance history. Built on the advanced S197 chassis platform, this model combined classic Mustang heritage with modern engineering, delivering both raw power and refined drivability. Under the hood sits the legendary supercharged 5.4L DOHC V8, factory-rated at 500 horsepower and 480 lb-ft of torque, paired to a 6-speed manual transmission. This powertrain was co-developed with Ford Special Vehicle Team (SVT), making it one of the most formidable Mustangs of its era. What truly sets this example apart is its condition and provenance: One owner since new Less than 300 original miles Completely stock and unmodified Preserved in \like new\ condition inside and out The chassis remains exactly as it left the factory-tight, unaltered, and free from wear-offering a driving and ownership experience that is essentially identical to 2007. From the factory suspension tuning to the original braking system, this GT500 represents a pure, unfiltered example of Shelby's return to production performance. The exterior and interior present as new, reflecting careful storage and meticulous ownership. This is not just a car-it's a preserved piece of modern muscle car history. Opportunities to acquire a launch-era GT500 in this condition, with this level of originality and mileage, are exceptionally rare. It lets you adjust the angle of the seatback for added comfort while you're driving, or for a more comfortable rest while you're pulled over. Settle in, with manual reclining driver seat.
  • Power 2-way driver lumbar - It's got your back. How you feel while driving is just as important as how your car drives. Enhance your comfort with power 2-way driver lumbar. Simply set it to the support you want for your lower back, and it will reduce the strain you would feel otherwise. Power 2-way driver lumbar supports your right to drive comfortably.
Convenience
  • Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed using the steering wheel mounted controls and it will maintain that speed without driver intervention. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Resting your right foot is right at your fingertips thanks to cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls.
Powertrain and Mechanical
  • Performance with punch. A DOHC valvetrain produces more power and runs at a higher speed than standard OHV engines so you can get where you're going faster.

This Escalade ESV Luxury is equipped with $1,725 in factory-installed options, including Galactic Grey Metallic exterior paint and the Floor Liner Package with all-weather integrated cargo liner and floor liners. Additional features include adaptive remote start, heated steering wheel, heated front seats, tri-zone automatic climate control, hands-free power liftgate, illuminated door handles, assist steps, and 22-inch bright silver wheels.

Safety and driver assistance features include HD surround vision, forward collision alert, automatic emergency braking, front pedestrian braking, rear pedestrian alert, lane keep assist with lane departure warning, safety alert seat, and front and rear park assist systems.
